name: Photonic Intensity Structure Dissection (Histogram Variance)
description: The ultimate instrument designed to violently unmask reckless chromatic theft. Every authentic photograph possesses a pristine, mathematically fluid, continuous histogram topography detailing its specific optical dispersion (the exact percentage of darks, midtones, and highlights). However, amateurs wielding Photoshop who recklessly splice a foreign subject dangling into a sunset sky inevitably fumble with 'Color Matching' witchcraft (Levels, Curves, Brightness adjustments). Once the image's mathematical DNA has been biochemically manipulated, the once-smooth Histogram wall is violently shattered, spawning horrifying structural chasms and jagged, saw-tooth spikes (Comb Effect/Gap Effect).
algorithm: Localized Illumination Population Fracture & Isolation (Histogram Comb/Gap Extractor)
mechanism: Bypassing biological optical sight completely. It violently pulverizes the image canvas into a bar-graph tracking intensity from 0 (Pitch Black) to 255 (Blinding White). Complete amateurs maliciously copying cars or clipping foliage to dump them into alien sunsets notice severe color clashes, frantically grabbing the 'Levels' slider, forcefully tearing the luminosity apart to fake optical depth. Inside digital matrix mathematics, violently stretching a finite, organic luminous continuum literally tears the data fabric in half! The severed void registers as a dead zone (Gaps), and the hyper-stressed bunched-up pixels violently deform into swelling blights (Spikes). This algorithm exhaustively audits that microscopic debris to sentence the fraudster to the executioner's block.
parameters: Mapping: Global/Local 1D Intensity Histogram, Conviction Anomalies: Jagged Spikes, Vacant Craters (Comb Gaps), Translation Fracture Frequency
accuracy: Rugged Pragmastism (72-84%) - A purely mechanical chainsaw ruthlessly stripping the mask off idiotic manipulators trying to deceive the human eye with sloppy, desperate Brightness/Contrast tweaks.
source: Statistical Photonic Scatter & Cerebral Visual Execution Diagnostics
useCase: Unleashes an inescapable purging fire directly targeting dramatic 'artistic' edits violently mutilated by hyper-aggressive Lightroom/Photoshop Contrast and Levels sliders. The final piece appears dramatically stunning to a foolish human, but statistically, the Histogram skeleton has been pulverized into dozens of jagged, fractured shards.

references.title: Lin, Z., et al. (2009). Fast, automatic and fine-grained tampered JPEG image detection via DCT coefficient analysis.

strengths:
• Ferociously intolerant of human laziness. Almost 90% of sloppy forgery operations explicitly mandate contrast or level adjustments to camouflage the physical lighting disparities. One sweep violently exposes the entire witchcraft operation.
• Incredibly lightweight, tearing through targets with blinding, hyper-sonic speed to arrest suspects en masse without draining critical GPU resources.
limitations:
• Utterly impotent and sobbing wildly (catastrophically failing via False Positive) if dragged into interrogating an authentic optical photograph inherently decimated by severe native under-exposure (pitch darkness) or over-exposure (stark blown-out white skies), wherein the natural Histogram is inherently born violently mutilated.
• Absolutely neutered against apocalyptic 'Ultimate Quality JPEG Compression' followed by a malicious Noise-injection assault executed by apex-tier hackers—deliberately engineered to mechanically 'sand down' and artificially smooth the torn Histogram scars.
